author: Alex Green
content: Payment failed 3 times while trying to checkout with Apple Pay. It charged my card but order didn't go through!

author: Sarah M.
content: Whenever I try to add my Mastercard, the app freezes and shows an unexpected payment gateway error.

author: Dmitry K.
content: Checkout screen gets stuck loading forever after tapping the Pay Now button. Very frustrating when shopping.

author: Linda B.
content: Cannot complete transaction! The checkout button is unresponsive and my credit card keeps getting declined.

author: Carlos R.
content: The payment process is completely broken after the latest patch. Tried with Visa and PayPal, both failed.

author: John Doe
content: Never received the OTP verification SMS code. Waited 15 minutes and requested resend 4 times.

author: Fatima A.
content: Verification codes via SMS arrive with a 20-minute delay, by which time they have already expired.

author: Mark S.
content: SMS OTP never arrives to international phone numbers. I am completely locked out of my account.

author: Elena V.
content: Why are security codes taking forever to arrive via SMS? I cannot log in on my new phone.

author: David P.
content: App crashes immediately upon opening on iOS 17. Cannot even reach the splash screen.

author: Anna W.
content: Since yesterday's 2.4.0 update, the app crashes right after launching. Please fix ASAP!

author: Brian T.
content: Constant crashes on startup. It closes itself after 2 seconds. Reinstalling did not help.

author: Michael N.
content: Amazing app! Love the clean interface and fast performance. Best in class.

author: Sophie L.
content: Super smooth experience. Customer support was very helpful when I had a question.

author: Kevin H.
content: Good application overall, but would love to have a dark mode option added in future.
